source: Map Data © Singapore Land Authority / OneMap. Height above scene water level in quarter-metres. Orthographic upper envelope of 652 meshes from 291 registered surveyed entities in Marina Bay scene revision 73. Rows follow increasing world Z and columns increasing X.
estimates: Upwind skyline obstruction is a proxy for short-wave shelter. The influence angle, angular fan and attenuation are visual estimates. Eight waterfront photographs were used to compare scale-dependent ripple contrast.
